name: 73. Bedrock unsigned-reasoning replay (#6624 / PR #6942)
description: Unsigned Claude thinking must be removed on replay. Covers Responses reasoning summaries, reasoning-only assistant message content (filtering must not leave content:null), and Chat reasoning_details, each unary and streaming. The response-rendering sibling is pinned with deterministic Go output fixtures because a request cannot force a live provider to return an unsigned embedded reasoning content block. A 400 or streamed error is a regression, not an infrastructure skip.
